title: Polish Cheesy Lasagna
description: A hearty, comforting lasagna dish with a Polish twist, featuring melted cheese and a rich, savory flavor.

ingredients.name: Polish Cheese Blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of cheddar and ricotta

instructions: Cook the lasagna sheets according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the resinous olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Polish cheese blend and stir until melted and smooth.
Combine the cooked lasagna sheets, cheese mixture, and mozzarella cheese in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
